question_zh: 周星馳的「I服了You」這句對白出自哪部電影？
question_en: Which film has the line 'I服了You'?
explanation_zh: 這句經典對白出自《大話西遊》。
explanation_en: This classic line is from 'A Chinese Odyssey'.
